'''Able Squadron''' was a group of [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL Y-wing starfighters]] in service of the [[Ripoblus government]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. They were attacked by [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele's]] wingmen during a mission to rescue a group of [[Ripoblus (people)|Ripoblus]] scientists who were trying to escape the conflict with the [[Dimok (people)|Dimoks]] in the [[Sepan system/Legends|Sepan system]].
